line_end_after_start.name: line_end_after_start
line_end_after_start.value: "app"."order_lines"."end_at" is null or "app"."order_lines"."start_at" is null or "app"."order_lines"."end_at" > "app"."order_lines"."start_at"

line_arrival_before_start.name: line_arrival_before_start
line_arrival_before_start.value: "app"."order_lines"."arrival_at" is null or "app"."order_lines"."start_at" is null or "app"."order_lines"."arrival_at" <= "app"."order_lines"."start_at"

tasks_open_dedupe.name: tasks_open_dedupe
tasks_open_dedupe.where: state in ('open','in_progress') and dedupe_key is not null
